correctness.rationale: For each r>=2,d>=1, each nonzero cycle distance has exactly one closer neighbor. The full multiset of distance-D-1 neighbors has cardinality M=d-j0 and coordinate sums S0=M*j0+j1, Si=(M-1)*ji+j(i+1) for 1<=i<r, which recursively determine the full profile. The induction proves every intermediate 1-WL partition, and the remaining two farthest layers show least stabilization round rd-1. Independent coordinate reflection/permutation symmetries and invariant refinement force orbit exactness; class sizes follow. Full-graph and independent weighted-quotient tests and predecessor reconstruction passed. No finite test is mistaken for a general proof.
